collegeFullAddress: BITSoM Knowledge Park, Powai, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400076
collegeInfo: Birla Institute of Technology & Science School of Management (BITSoM) is an independent business school under the BITS Pilani brand. Launched in 2021, BITSoM offers a world-class, globally networked MBA program led by distinguished international faculty in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The curriculum emphasizes leadership, digital transformation, innovation, and multidisciplinary management skills.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Based on academic excellence and holistic profile as assessed during admissions.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Considered during application review. No separate application required.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: For students from low-income backgrounds, based on family income and application review.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Application and supporting documents required during admissions.

events.eventFullDescription: LEAD is BITSoM's annual leadership conclave. It features keynote speakers, fireside chats, and interactive sessions with global business leaders, entrepreneurs, and innovators.
Emerge is a festival focused on entrepreneurship, innovation, and new-age business models, featuring startup showcases, workshops, investor panels, and pitch competitions.

infrastructure.infraDescription:
BITSoM operates from the vibrant Powai campus of BITS Pilani in Mumbai Metropolitan Region (to be fully operational by 2025). Facilities include modern digital classrooms, smart lecture halls, analytics labs, leadership centers, well-stocked library, innovation hubs, and recreational amenities. The campus encourages peer learning, community engagement, and leadership development.

Academic Infrastructure:

  • Advanced smart classrooms and digital collaboration spaces.

  • Library: Digital and print collection with access to global databases and journals.

Residential Facilities:

  • Hostel accommodation with modern amenities and a diverse cohort.

Sports & Fitness:

  • Gymnasium, sports courts, wellness center, and student lounges.
